func externalAgentBinaryFixture(goos, name string) (string, string) {
	infoJSON := `{"protocol_version":1,"name":"` + name + `","type":"` + name + ` Agent","description":"External test agent","is_preview":false,"protected_dirs":[],"hook_names":["stop"],"capabilities":{"hooks":true}}`

	if goos == "windows" {
		script := "@echo off\r\n" +
			"if \"%1\"==\"info\" goto info\r\n" +
			"if \"%1\"==\"detect\" goto detect\r\n" +
			"if \"%1\"==\"install-hooks\" goto installhooks\r\n" +
			"if \"%1\"==\"uninstall-hooks\" exit /b 0\r\n" +
			"if \"%1\"==\"are-hooks-installed\" goto arehooksinstalled\r\n" +
			"echo {}\r\n" +
			"exit /b 0\r\n" +
			":info\r\n" +
			"echo " + infoJSON + "\r\n" +
			"exit /b 0\r\n" +
			":detect\r\n" +
			"if \"%ENTIRE_TEST_EXTERNAL_PRESENT%\"==\"1\" (\r\n" +
			"  echo {\"present\": true}\r\n" +
			") else (\r\n" +
			"  echo {\"present\": false}\r\n" +
			")\r\n" +
			"exit /b 0\r\n" +
			":installhooks\r\n" +
			"echo {\"hooks_installed\": 1}\r\n" +
			"exit /b 0\r\n" +
			":arehooksinstalled\r\n" +
			"echo {\"installed\": false}\r\n" +
			"exit /b 0\r\n"

		return "entire-agent-" + name + ".bat", script
	}

	script := `#!/bin/sh
case "$1" in
  info)
    echo '` + infoJSON + `'
    ;;
  detect)
    if [ "$ENTIRE_TEST_EXTERNAL_PRESENT" = "1" ]; then
      echo '{"present": true}'

      echo '{"present": false}'
    fi
    ;;
  install-hooks)
    echo '{"hooks_installed": 1}'
    ;;
  uninstall-hooks)
    exit 0
    ;;
  are-hooks-installed)
    echo '{"installed": false}'
    ;;
  *)
    echo '{}'
    ;;
esac
`

	return "entire-agent-" + name, script
}
